verdict.rationale: Glama's docs say you can search and compare thousands of MCP servers in its curated catalog of open-source servers and remote connectors, and inspect each one's capabilities. A live probe of llms.txt shows a directory of about 91.6k servers and 23.7k connectors, each scanned and scored, and the browser inspector lets you test any server before wiring it in. Community posts confirm the catalog's size and its quality-score system; the 'sea of existing ones' comment is about marketing a new server, not about search failing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of capability-based filtering or facets, and hands-on reports of the search experience itself.
